entities.name: Hanoi–Thái Nguyên railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Hanoi–Quán Triều railway is a railway line serving the country of Vietnam. It is a single-track standard-gauge and metre-gauge line connecting from Hanoi to Thái Nguyên, for a total length of 120 km (75 mi).
